mechanism: Functions are values; closures over mutable environments. No purity. Prototypes and `this` sit beside the FP subset.
why: Scheme-in-the-browser was the original pitch; the Java-shaped `this` arrived for HTML event handlers.
useWhen: Callbacks, array pipelines, React function components.
price: Mutation and `this`-binding make 'just functions' a dialect, not the language.
